issues.concern: Tag 'journalism' is not in the valid tag list.

The English translation 'A reporter came to do an interview' misrepresents the Japanese. While 'interview' is part of '取材', the Japanese implies the reporter came to gather information/report, not necessarily to be interviewed themselves.
issues.suggestion: A reporter came to gather information/report.

issues.concern: The English translation 'I'm going to be interviewed' misrepresents the Japanese. '取材を受ける' means to be the subject of news gathering/reporting, not necessarily an interview in the sense of answering questions.
issues.suggestion: I'm going to be covered by the media / I'm going to be the subject of a report.
